mapper.select: SELECT term_price_id, term_version_id, entity_no, payment_method_profile_code, priority_no, settlement_business_days, business_calendar_code, settlement_timezone, cutoff_second_of_day FROM t_commercial_term_price WHERE term_version_id IN (SELECT term_version_id FROM t_commercial_term_version WHERE term_plan_id IN (SELECT term_plan_id FROM t_commercial_term_plan WHERE client_id = #{clientId} OR local_partner_id IN (SELECT source_partner_id FROM t_entity_source_relation WHERE entity_no IN (SELECT entity_no FROM t_client_entity_affiliation WHERE client_id = #{clientId}) AND source_type='PARTNER'))) AND entity_no IN (SELECT entity_no FROM t_client_entity_affiliation WHERE client_id = #{clientId}) ORDER BY term_price_id
